summary: The authenticated Home screen still looked like a plain vertical menu/list instead of a materially improved dashboard.
details: Observed profile row, Today heading, two flat actions, menu rows, More rows, and large unused space on wider desktop/test viewport.
Observed implementation-oriented copy: No global shared-bill count is exposed by this mobile seam yet.
The screen read more like a settings/navigation hub than a useful Home dashboard.
fixSummary: Home now has a centered phone-width dashboard surface on wide test windows instead of a stretched desktop layout.
Home now has a compact dashboard header with user context plus refresh, notification, and profile affordances.
Two top metric cards show You owe and You're owed with honest zero or server-provided settlement balance values.
Upcoming bills now uses bill-like rows or a compact honest empty state instead of Personal bills and Recurring bills route cards as primary content.
Group activity now uses feed-style rows or a compact honest empty state instead of Shared bills and Notifications route cards as primary content.
Quick actions, Needs attention, Upcoming bills, Group activity, This month, and compact More controls remain explicit sections.
The shared-bills copy is user-facing and no longer mentions seams or unavailable implementation details.
The layout is constrained and adaptive for narrow and wide viewports, with focused tests covering both and route handoffs.

summary: Home dashboard was missing persistent bottom navigation and Create bill routed directly to personal bill creation.
details: The M2 reference direction expects Home to show a persistent bottom navigation with Home, Bills, Groups, Settle, and Settings.
Home Create bill should ask whether the user wants a personal bill or group bill.
Group selection must be optional and must not break the personal bill path.
fixSummary: Home now uses the scaffold bottom navigation bar with Home, Bills, Groups, Settle, and Settings labels.
Home is selected while the dashboard is visible.
Create bill now opens a chooser with Personal bill and Group bill choices.
Personal bill keeps the existing personal bill create screen.
Group bill opens Groups so the user can choose a group and continue through the existing group bill list/create flow.
knownLimitation: Home does not preselect a group for group bill creation because the current mobile shell has no safe group-selection/preselection API; the Group bill choice routes to Groups for explicit group selection.

summary: A non-Home page showed bottom navigation drift with extra Receipts and Profile tabs instead of the canonical M2 five-tab shell.
details: The observed bottom navigation used Home, Bills, Groups, Settle, Receipts, and Profile.
The M2 Day 1 shell direction expects Home, Bills, Groups, Settle, and Settings only.
Receipts, Profile, sessions, reports, and receipt reviews should remain secondary routes/actions rather than bottom navigation tabs.
fixSummary: The mobile shell now uses one shared bottom navigation widget with Home, Bills, Groups, Settle, and Settings in that order.
Home, Bills, Groups, Settle, and Settings/Profile top-level routes share the same constrained safe-area nav layout, icon size, label behavior, and rounded active indicator.
Receipts and Profile are not bottom-nav tab labels.
Top-level tab active state is covered for Home, Bills, Groups, Settle, and Settings.
The Create bill chooser still exposes Personal bill and Group bill.
